title: Death messages enhanced
description: This project adds a few more death messages to troll your friends!
body:
Death Messages Enhanced
Are you tired of the same old, boring vanilla death messages? "Player fell from a high place" just doesn't capture the sheer embarrassment of missing a water bucket clutch.

Death Messages Enhanced transforms your server's chat into a  comedy arena. Every time a player dies the plugin suppresses the generic Minecraft broadcast and replaces it with a completely customizable, dynamic roast!

 Features
 Pure Slapstick: Randomly selects from a pool of hilarious, dramatic death roasts.

 Modern Text Formatting: Built natively for Paper 1.21.11, meaning it perfectly supports MiniMessage hex colors, gradients, bold accents, and hover effects right out of the box.

 100% Configurable: An auto-generating config.yml lets you add, remove, or edit the roasts to perfectly fit your server's community vibe.
